name: cantilena
description: Sings the lyrics of a score for notation extensions such as Lily#: notes with syllables in, a voice out — through your own installation of NEUTRINO, or DiffSinger voices in the OpenUtau format. Open source (Apache-2.0); runs locally on Windows.

cantilena.neutrinoFolder.markdownDescription:
The folder of your NEUTRINO installation (Tau, v3.2 or later): the one holding `bin\`, `model\` and `settings\`. NEUTRINO is not bundled — it is free software of STUDIO NEUTRINO under its own terms, from [studio-neutrino.com](https://studio-neutrino.com/). Empty: no NEUTRINO voice can be sung (a DiffSinger voices folder is the other engine).

**[Choose the folder…](command:cantilena.chooseNeutrinoFolder)**

cantilena.voicesFolder.markdownDescription:
The folder whose subfolders are DiffSinger voices in the OpenUtau format (each holding a `dsconfig.yaml`, as OpenUtau installs them). Each voice is its author's work under its author's terms; none is bundled. Empty: no DiffSinger voice can be sung.

**[Choose the folder…](command:cantilena.chooseVoicesFolder)**

cantilena.vocoderFolder.markdownDescription: A vocoder folder (holding `vocoder.yaml` and its model) for DiffSinger voices that bundle none. Most voices bundle their own; leave this empty then.

cantilena.voice.markdownDescription:
The voice the lyrics are sung in, as `engine/name`: `neutrino/` and a folder under NEUTRINO's `model\` (MERROW ships with NEUTRINO), or `diffsinger/` and a folder under the voices folder. Other voices are their authors' work under their authors' terms, installed there by you. A bare name means a NEUTRINO voice.

**[Choose a voice…](command:cantilena.chooseVoice)**

cantilena.gpu.markdownDescription: Render on the GPU when NEUTRINO can (CUDA). Off: the CPU, slower by an order of magnitude.

cantilena.program.markdownDescription: For developers: the `cantilena` program to run instead of the one bundled with this extension (a build from the repository).
